comment: The interface languages (ROADMAP 10.4; docs/spec/localisation.md). Each has translations/cutthulhu_<code>.ts, made and kept up to date by scripts/update-translations.py; English is the source and needs no file. To add a language: a line here, then scripts/update-translations.py, then translate the new .ts in Qt Linguist (CONTRIBUTING.md, Translations).
